# gitmoap_provider (Data Source)

Get one provider's metadata. The provider's name, description, tier, publisher, latest version, and the credentials a connection to it needs. A private provider is visible only to members of the organization that owns it; anyone else gets `404`. Open to any signed-in caller.

The token needs `provider_catalog:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "provider_id" {
  type = string
}

data "gitmoap_provider" "example" {
  id = var.provider_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Provider slug

### Read-Only

- `auth_modes` (List of String) How connections to this provider may authenticate (e.g.
`[static_credentials, oidc_federation]`). A connection using any other mode is refused.
- `categories` (List of String) The marketplace categories the provider is listed under, one to three. Empty for a provider
with no marketplace listing.
- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `featured_rank` (Number) Where gitmoap features the provider: lower numbers are placed higher. Absent when it is not
featured.
- `install_count` (Number) How many organizations have installed the provider. Providers installed by default are not
counted.
- `keywords` (List of String) Search keywords from the provider's marketplace listing, up to 10.
- `latest_version` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `publisher_id` (String)
- `tier` (String) How a pipeline provider is distributed and how much it is vouched for.
- `updated_at` (String)
